citations.claim: Controller force 6.5 exceeds fmax 5 at first step

counterfactual.change: Set controller noise 1 -> 0; force stays within fmax and no violation occurs, showing noise term bypasses force clamp.

explanation: With seeded sensor noise enabled, controller commands 6.5 N exceeding fmax 5 N at step 1. Without noise the same geometry/ gains command within limit. Likely cause: noise is added to velocity error / force after the fmax clamp (or clamp applied before noise), so noisy command bypasses the limit.
vision_note: The red controller body starts on the left side far from its green waypoint in the upper right. From step 0 to step 1 it remains essentially in place with no visible progress toward the waypoint.
